title: Hypermotard 698 Mono Supermoto (Dark Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Ducati Hypermotard 698 Mono Supermoto (Dark Edition) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
